content.comment_body: Hello, I created an application using [product_name] and would like to make it accessible online from any location. What steps do I need to take? Please share your recommendations.

Hello, Depending on whether your network is private, home, or business, there are several approaches. Assuming you're on a home network, you can configure your router's NAT (Network Address Translation) to forward the HTTP port to the local IP address for your [product_name]. By entering your WAN IP address in a browser, you'll be directed to the device configured in NAT. This way, you can access your [product_name] externally. For details on setting up NAT, please refer to your router’s manual.
